cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes through a universal Oral Glucose Tolerance Test screening program (199 women in 2012-2013 and 203 women in 2016-2017)
finding: Despite a shift in demographics towards more women with hereditary predisposition and non-Scandinavian ethnicity, improved metabolic control was observed in women diagnosed with gestational diabetes in 2016-2017 compared to 2012-2013, accompanied by a decrease in insulin use and an increase in metformin use, without significant differences in pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found no differences in the frequency of cesarean section between the two time periods examined.
